Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows belonging to assay CHEMBL1614421. Join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures to obtain canonical SMILES and molecule ChEMBL IDs. Filter to include only rows where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is exactly '='. Do not deduplicate; return every qualifying activity row. Sort the results by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
